requirements:
pytest==7.0.1
pytest-cov==4.0.0
black==22.10.0
flake8==5.0.4
mypy==0.991
requests==2.28.1
beautifulsoup4==4.11.1
lxml==4.9.1
dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "-m", "pytest"]
explanation: Generated requirements.txt includes testing (pytest, pytest-cov), code formatting (black), linting (flake8), type checking (mypy), and web scraping utilities (requests, beautifulsoup4, lxml) based on detected imports. Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim base, installs dependencies, and defaults to running tests.
